title: chatId/spaceId/channelId referential integrity not enforced
description: Scene's optional binding fields (chatId, spaceId, channelId on SceneRegion) are foreign keys to Chat/Space objects, but no validation is specified. If a client sets chatId to a non-existent Chat or one the user can't access, no SetError is defined. Chat carries no back-reference to SceneRegion, so linkage is one-directional and unvalidated. Need to specify invalidArguments or notFound errors for dangling binding references.
